== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-gregory-shaw-ds-walkers/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Shaw DS Walkers.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114003422/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-gregory-shaw-ds-walkers.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>975edaee92c92c627dd309668375d05846093f2dbda01c27d236188899938c93</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.
